title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode6 Wanna Start a Band?

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Is everybody ready?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hold on... How do we start?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sigh... Honami, count us in.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay. Here it goes... One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It's the first time we've played together since that time at Saki's house.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We struggled to keep pace with each other then, but everyone was doing their best, and it was a lot of fun.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm loving this! Everyone's parts are coming together in this song! Maybe we could start a band again, and things between us could be the way they used to be...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Stop.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika, Saki, you're falling behind. Follow Honami's beat.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: S-Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is precisely why I didn't want to do this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
B-But wasn't it sort of good, considering?
We actually synched up really well at the start!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm not interested in playing sort of good.
You should know that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Sh-Shiho, there's no need to get so worked up about this.
Let's try again, from the beginning. Okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you mind if I joined you this time?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You want to play with us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Do you not want me to?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What, no, I didn't mean it like that...
It would be amazing, if you're really okay playing with us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Watching you play made me want to pick up an instrument too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sigh... Whatever. Let's just get this over with.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, I'll start again. One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Wow... Miku joined in so seamlessly...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (And somehow her playing's encouraging everyone!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She really is something else...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you for letting me join in.
I could tell that this song means a lot to you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho and Honami both remembered how to play this song.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Could it be they too hoped that one day, we'd...
Maybe that's just wishful thinking.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, are we done? Because I want to go back.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What is it now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, Hona, Ichi... Let's get the band back together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Us, together?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you joking?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh come ON, we had so much fun just now, right?
Wasn't it fun, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, it wasn't...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even Miku noticed this song has a special place in our hearts. I think that you and Honami actually liked playing it, even though you won't admit it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't want to be in a band with you. Period.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry but I don't think I want to do this either.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona... You, too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I knew it seemed too easy...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've had enough. Tell me how to get out of here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course. You did as promised, and I'll keep my word.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You all played a track just before you appeared here, remember? Called Untitled.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Untitled is the gateway to this world.
Play it to be transported here, stop it to leave.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So it was that track...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That silent track got us here?
Whatever, at least now I can get back out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Bye.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then I'll be going too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Looks like we're not all friends anymore...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you giving up?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you sure they don't want to be friends?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're right. If I give up now, we'll lose any chance we might have at getting back together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I don't have a plan or anything, but I'm not giving up, that's for sure!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's the way. And if you want to play
together again, you can come here anytime.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
...
Miku, can I ask you something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why are you here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Songs are crystallizations of feelings.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Um, right...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just like SEKAI, songs are born from feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You and your friends need to find out what your true feelings are for them to turn into a song.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And I'm here to help guide you towards that
truth.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're going to help us figure out our feelings...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope you can do it soon. You, and your friends.
